description_text: Farragut State Park is a massive 4,000-acre park on Lake Pend Oreille, featuring hiking trails, disc golf, and a rich history as a WWII naval training base.
campground_text: Offers multiple modern loops with full hookups, water/electricity, cabins, group camps, and modern restrooms/showers.

description_text: Bruneau Dunes State Park boasts the tallest single-structured sand dune in North America, featuring lake fishing, sandboarding, and an observatory.
campground_text: Campground provides electric and water hookups, primitive sites, equestrian camping, hot showers, and a dump station.

description_text: Ponderosa State Park occupies a peninsula on Payette Lake, covered in towering ponderosa pines, offering hiking, biking, and winter recreation.
campground_text: Wooded campground featuring electric/water hookups, deluxe cabins, modern bathhouses, and beach access.

description_text: Priest Lake State Park lies in the deep forest of northern Idaho along the pristine waters of Priest Lake, offering scenic vistas of the Selkirk Mountains.
campground_text: Multiple campgrounds (Indian Creek, Lionhead, Dickensheet) offer full hookups, water/electricity, cabins, and flush restrooms.

address: 3917 Henrys Lake Rd, Island Park, ID 83429
seasonal_notes: Closed in winter due to snow (typically Oct-May).
description_text: Henrys Lake State Park is a high-mountain park offering premier trout fishing, mountain views, wildflowers, and close proximity to Yellowstone.
campground_text: Lakeside campground with water and electric hookups, camping cabins, a dump station, and flush restrooms/showers.

description_text: Lucky Peak State Park, located close to Boise, consists of three units (Discovery, Sandy Point, Spring Shores) offering swimming, boating, and picnicking along the Boise River and Lucky Peak Reservoir.
